level_names.admin1: region (viloyat), the city of Tashkent, or the Republic of Karakalpakstan (OSM admin_level 3; added to `board.py children Uzbekistan` through also_children)

tips.plate/area-code/calling-code: plate region code (two digits in the box on the left; each region holds a range, 01–09 Tashkent city … 95–99 Karakalpakstan) or landline code (two digits after +998) readable → `clues.py lookup plate|area-code <value> --country uz` + `board.py apply`; a plate with a letter and four digits after the code is the 1998–2008 format: `--kind plate-1998`
tips.livery: car and bus make is not a region marker in Uzbekistan: Chevrolet cars from the national plants are everywhere. Read the plate's region code from vehicles instead (`clues.py lookup plate <two digits> --country uz`)
